answer: Each attested answer mints claimable balance at a rate capped by that identity's verified stake, and the credit sits in a lock that vests only as the same address keeps answering in later epochs. A Sybil farmer must fund every puppet up front, and a fresh identity has zero history, so its credit stays locked. Hopping between puppets resets the lock, collapsing output while capital stays pinned. Cost scales with headcount; payoff per head stays flat. That asymmetry keeps a plume of vanity addresses from becoming a vine of power: one lotus and patience beat duplication.
